name: FNF: From the Top!
summary:
5 ORIGINAL SONGS.
Babybatter, I'm Scary Guye, BeRzErKeR, Soundcheck and the newest song in v5.0: HEIGHTS & FRIGHTS, an original song featuring a beautiful christmas tune with Girlfriend and THE (definitely real) Santa Claus!

Still hungry for more? Good news, there's plenty where that came from.

16 REMIXES.
Full remixes of Tutorial, Week 1, 2, 3, 4 and Week 5, with spicy new events and backdrops that revitalize original concepts and scrapped ideas!

Hopefully they invoke the same feeling of hype you got the first time you played them!

FULL LIP-SYNCING AND UNIQUE RATING-BASED POSES.
All playable characters have 36(!!) total animations that change depending on the note sung in the song, and your rating! Even the ones you don't play as still have a pretty impressive 12 different note sprites. (And don't worry nerds, the animations use animation atlases. ;3)

It'll either stroke your ego or spit in your face depending on your skill level.
